Name: Electric Bulletin Board

Description:
[s]The bulletin board itself is fixed and does not change with time.I wrote the game's version number because I thought it would look strange if I indicated a specific time.[/s]

An option to display the time has been added.
Thanks to ”Shockah" for creating the configuration option!

It currently includes English, Japanese and Chinese translation files.
